sourceMetadata.sampling: First unlocked self-draw win window per seat per baseline round; all four seats; dealer rotates by seed offset.
sourceMetadata.uncertainty: Conditional on actual concealed opponent hands AND remaining tile inventory. Only wall order is permuted; not a public-information posterior.
sourceMetadata.policies: One forced action, then unchanged local EV for all seats until settlement. Candidate roles are preselected using only seat view.
sourceMetadata.interval: Seed-cluster bootstrap over mean paired permutation deltas; original wall excluded from inference. Exploratory, not multiplicity-adjusted.

caveat: Selected cases; intervals cover only wall-order Monte Carlo uncertainty, not source-game sampling or unknown opponents. Not general policy strength.
